replies.author: PawsUnpaws_
replies.body:
Ehhhn, I'd reconsider putting the monuments in the center like that. It'd be really hard to break the monuments because they're right in the middle, and who ever attempts to break it would be completely surrounded by the opposing team. Also the fact that it's covered in water makes it increasingly difficult. I could see a match lasting a half hour easily.
But hey, it's your map.
